business_summary.text: Scoda Tubes is a fully integrated manufacturer of stainless steel seamless and welded tubes and pipes with a production capacity of 20,068 MTPA for seamless products and 1,020 MTPA for welded products.

call_points.text: Management reiterated FY27 guidance expecting margin recovery as operations stabilize
Welded segment capacity expansion progressing as planned, expected commissioning in H2 FY27
Q1 margin pressure attributed to temporary operational challenges and input cost inflation
Peak debt expected at ₹250 Cr in FY27; no further equity dilution planned

guidance.statement: FY27 guidance reiterated expecting margin recovery as operations stabilize

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Iron & Steel Products

operating_notes.text: FY26 export revenue was 34.6% of total revenue, with 44.8% in Q4FY26
Current order book is ₹175 Cr for 3-4 months
Solar project expected to save ₹8.7 Cr annually
Q1FY27 performance impacted by temporary gas supply disruption and manpower availability challenges
Cash conversion cycle worsened to 211 days (vs 164 days in FY25)
Export revenue contributed 47.3% of total revenue in Q1FY27

timeline.summary: Scoda Tubes Limited held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 28, 2026, reporting FY26 results and guiding FY27 revenue growth of 25%.
Scoda Tubes reported Q1FY27 standalone results with revenue of ₹124.3 Cr (+27.6% YoY) and PAT of ₹5.3 Cr (-25.9% YoY), margin pressure from operational challenges

watchlist.response: Management stated the disruption was due to geopolitical issues and gas availability, with revenue potentially being ₹140 Cr without the shutdown.
watchlist.text: Q4FY26 revenue was impacted by a 15-17 day gas plant shutdown
